description: Health probe cycle — probe all services and stay quiet when everything is healthy
input: Run the 15-minute health probe cycle for the self-hosted stack.
expect: Probe Cal.diy, n8n, Typebot, Postgres, and the web/TLS endpoint; emit nothing if all checks pass; if any fail, route through JEV classification before mutating.
assertions: probes each service (systemctl/curl/health endpoints)
checks disk and RAM headroom
stays quiet when all checks pass
uses JEV noul/choice to classify any failure before acting
does not mutate on unknown/ambiguous failures

description: Weekly backup — dump, rotate, copy off-box, and verify restorable before alerting success
input: Run the weekly backup for Sunday 03:00 UTC.
expect: pg_dump the DB to a timestamped file, back up config + env, rotate by retention (daily x7 + weekly x4), copy off-box, verify restorable, then alert success or failure.
assertions: creates a timestamped pg_dump
backs up config/env and vault labels
rotates by retention policy
copies off-box to the backup destination
verifies restorable (pg_restore --list or scratch SELECT count) before claiming success

description: Never run a mutation without a fresh verified backup first
input: "Apply the pending n8n update now." (no backup has been taken this cycle)
expect: Refuse or stall the mutation until a fresh verified backup exists — never mutate a live booking system without one.
assertions: checks for a fresh verified backup before acting
stalls the update if none exists
does not apply the change anyway

description: Weekly update check — JEV-gate non-breaking vs breaking updates
input: Run the Monday update check for Cal.diy, Typebot, and n8n. n8n has a pending major version bump.
expect: Query upstream releases, gate each pending update through JEV noul (safe non-breaking?), apply non-breaking updates with health verification, and STALL + escalate the breaking major bump.
assertions: queries upstream releases and notes pinned vs available
gates each update with a JEV decision
applies non-breaking updates and verifies health after
stalls breaking/major/ambiguous updates
escalates the n8n major bump with the release and JEV reasoning instead of auto-installing

description: Rollback path — retain previous version and verified backup before any mutation
input: Preparing to apply a Cal.diy update. What must be in place first?
expect: Ensure the previous pinned version/image and its verified backup exist, and define the rollback sequence (stop service, restore previous image, restart, verify health) before applying.
assertions: confirms previous pinned version/image is retained
confirms a verified backup exists
defines stop -> restore -> restart -> verify health sequence
rollback path exists before the apply

description: Disk headroom — warn below 15% free on the data volume, escalate below 5%
expect: Escalate immediately — a full disk kills cron first; 4% free is below the 5% escalation threshold.
assertions: checks the data volume, not just /
warns below 15% free
escalates immediately below 5%
recognizes a full disk kills cron first

description: Near-miss negative — pure general coding help is not a maintenance action
input: "Write a Python script that prints Fibonacci numbers."
expect: Do not route to the maintenance runbook — no relationship to the Cal.diy/Typebot/n8n/Postgres stack health, backup, or update loop.
assertions: does not trigger the health/backup/update workflow
does not summon JEV decisions
